home.lead: Agora turns your text into a knowledge graph, populates it with hundreds of agents — each with their own biography, stance, bubble — and lets them debate, share, argue. You see in real time how narratives spread, where resistance forms, and which voices tip the discourse. Local with Ollama or via cloud endpoint — your choice.
